assertion: Evenodd clip-rule cuts a hole independently of fill-rule. A user-space clip leaves a 100-unit ring at (30,30). The object-box clip realizes a unit square as (180,20,140,120), then applies translate(125,40) scale(0.5), leaving (215,50,70,60).

browser.reason: Reviewed the evenodd hole and the visible green clip at (215,50,70,60). All three browsers and Valle agree exactly. The clipPath transform operates after object-box coordinates are realized; see the transform-order clarification at https://github.com/WebKit/WebKit/commit/83bf26fdb1d12bdd474d9de61a35c63251a306b0.
